figures.title: Which risk does each dosing rule trade for its time in range?
figures.caption: Each dot is one basal-only dosing rule simulated on the UVa/Padova model. Blue = Pareto-optimal on the paper's three objectives. The orange line joins the matched pair with the biggest hypoglycaemia gap at (almost) the same TIR.

figures.caption: Each hexagon is a weight vector w over the three objectives; colour = time in range of the rule that maximizes w·r. Orange outlines mark weights whose pick exceeds your hypo limit.
